highlights_headline: The 4.156.3 servicing changes correct image filtering, glyph cropping and GPU draw handling without changing managed APIs.

bullets.detail: Ganesh image filters avoid mipmaps that can sample unwritten scratch-texture pixels. FreeType LCD16 glyph copies use pixel-space bounds and consistently crop source and destination when successive glyph loads produce different outlines.

Ganesh rejects overflowing buffer allocations and skips draws when allocation fails, and destination reads are clipped to their bounds. Graphite resets depth and bounds after full-overwrite draws so repeated overwrites do not wrap depth and change painter order.
